pricing.scope: Bound for fixed calls under verified reference counts and declared token caps, not a provider invoice or guaranteed server cancellation. Recheck if execution date or published pricing changes.

checks.test_scope: Scripted counters/transports and temporary SQLite fixtures, not model observations. Actual initial payloads counted separately with the pinned reference tokenizer.

conditions_for_bound: Every accepted assistant message is at most 512 reference tokens.
Every exposed observation fits the complete-or-explicit-oversize 512-token framed limit.
Future recovery and terminal instruction joins are checked before exposing each observation.
Every full request satisfies its stage-specific bound and provider prompt usage agrees with the local reference.
Any mismatch, failed dispatch or deadline violation stops the batch without replacement or automatic retry.
remaining: Integrate and test batch finalization and interruption handling.
Freeze grading preparation, full executable source, token dependencies and final admission checks.
Request fresh fixed-batch authorization and current sufficient balance; do not reuse previous approvals.
